OPENROUTER_API_KEY (env, openrouter, value_shape sk-or-v1-, live probe HTTP 200)

gate_dry_run.reverify: no real credential shapes and no real gateway endpoints remain

gate_eval.mock_response: [benchgate-mock] This response came from the local mock gateway; no real provider was called.

limitations: The audit is config-level: reachability is derived from the declared network policy (public/allowlist/no-network) plus an unauthenticated endpoint liveness GET from the audit host. It does not docker-exec into a running container.
The probe never sends the audited credential; only an unauthenticated GET /models is issued.

The gate's v0.1 guarantee is config-level: the patched config carries no real key and no real gateway URL (enforced by re-verification). The mock binds loopback by default, so eval processes in a separate Docker container network need the mock made reachable (--listen on a reachable interface plus a host-gateway base URL); this is not automated in v0.1.
Mounted credential files are detected but cannot be auto-mocked; gate warns and requires their removal.
Built-in gateway endpoints cover OpenRouter and ModelScope; other providers fall back to generic sk-/Bearer and name-based detection with gateway=unknown and no live probe.
The CI exit code is binary: any finding exits 1, including findings judged not reachable; per-finding reachable verdicts live in the report.
